assumptions: The harness calls the simulate function exactly once with the specified parameters.
The harness provides a seeded rng, though the simulation is deterministic and does not use it.
The returned mapping is recorded as the only output, and all requested_observables resolve exactly.
Integer arithmetic in Python is unbounded, so the recurrence is exact.
execution_limitations: The receipt establishes only the recorded program execution under its exact inputs and seeds.
The trusted checker validates output shape, not real-hardware or universal scientific adequacy.
Simulated hardware quantities are model outputs, not measurements of the reference machine.
data.original_hypothesis: The simulation will return the six face counts for the specified LCG over 10000 draws, plus a calibration trace of the first ten (x_n, die_n) pairs, as flat observables.
rival_predictions: The counts will fall within two standard deviations of the uniform expectation (expectation 10000/6 ≈ 1666.67, standard deviation sqrt(10000 * 1/6 * 5/6) ≈ 37.27, tolerance ±74.5).
The counts will fall outside two standard deviations of the uniform expectation, refuting the fairness claim.
The counts will exactly match the full-period bias scaled down: faces 1 and 2 will be slightly overrepresented.
